physics_goals.quote: Search for the Majorana Nature of Neutrinos in the Inverted Mass Ordering Region with KamLAND-Zen
physics_goals.value: Search for neutrinoless double-beta decay of 136Xe dissolved in liquid scintillator, probing the inverted neutrino-mass-ordering region

summary.plain: A xenon-loaded balloon of liquid suspended inside the KamLAND detector deep under a Japanese mountain, searching for a rare radioactive process in xenon atoms. Its latest result sets one of the strongest limits yet on the process.
summary.technical: KamLAND-Zen: 745 kg of xenon (enriched in 136Xe) dissolved in liquid scintillator inside a balloon suspended within the KamLAND detector at Kamioka. The KamLAND-Zen 800 phase's complete dataset (2.1 t·yr exposure) sets T1/2 0ν > 3.8×10²⁶ yr (90% C.L.), improving on the prior phase's 970 kg·yr / 2.3×10²⁶ yr limit.

unique_capabilities.quote: The KamLAND-Zen experiment has provided stringent constraints on the neutrinoless double-beta (0νββ) decay half-life in 136Xe using a xenon-loaded liquid scintillator.
unique_capabilities.value: Reuses an existing large liquid-scintillator detector (KamLAND) as an ultra-low-background outer veto for an inner xenon-loaded balloon, avoiding the cost of a dedicated new detector
